text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The day of the Kikuka Sho has arrived. Fans are brimming with high expectations, eager to see how the BNW trio has progressed since the Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Winning Ticket heads out with one goal in mind—to show the audience a heated and exciting race.
